sentences.text: Shri Raghvendra Verma, Advocate for the respondent No.3.
Heard on I.A. No. 01/2024 application for under section 5 of the Limitation Act.

Though opposed, but for the reasons mentioned in the application; Motor Vehicle Act is a benevolent legislation; the appellant is a minor, this Court is satisfied that the appellant has shown sufficient cause for filing the appeal.
Thus, the application is allowed and delay of 117 days in filing the appeal is hereby condoned.
Shri Verma, Advocate accepts notice on behalf of the respondent No.3.

As the liability to pay compensation is upon the respondent No.3 / Insurance Company, at the request of Shri Kesharwani, Advocate notice to the respondent Nos. 1 and 2 is dispense with for the present.
List the case for final hearing in the month of August, 2026.
